newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won ends up on hopes of month-end exports.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won ends up on hopes of month-end exports.

text.p: The won finished higher versus the dollar on Thursday boosted by the expectation of end-of-the-month export deals, dealers said.
The won closed at 891.80 against Wednesday's closing of 892.20. It opened at 891.70 and moved in a range of 891.40 to 892.20.
Traders said despite the overall bullishness of the local unit, the won closely followed the dollar/yen movement in world markets throughout the day.
